context_requirements: DPP4 (CD26) expression on the target cell; most of the nine lines are not known to express DPP4 at levels sufficient for a direct transcriptional response
An intact immune compartment for the immune-mediated cytokine/chemokine effects described for PT-100; these are in vitro monocultures of human cell lines
For any FAP-dependent effect, fibroblast activation protein expression in stromal cells, which is absent in pure tumor cell line cultures
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines after 10 micromolar DPP4 inhibitor
Induction of cytokine or chemokine landmark genes (e.g., CXCL2, CCL2, IL1B) in these monocultures
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent with vehicle and not explained by vehicle or general toxicity

evidence.supports: PT-100, a DPP inhibitor, has no direct cytotoxic effect on tumor cells in vitro; its antitumor activity is immune-mediated and requires hematopoietic/stromal tissue, so no direct transcriptional response is expected in these cell lines
